testCases.testName: Confirm PCR7 says 'Binding Possible or Bound' from MSINFO32

testScenarios.objective: Objective: Open MSINFO Elevated and verify PCR7 Configuration says “Binding Possible”
testScenarios.detailedSteps:
Procedure:
1. Enter UEFI menu (instructions at beginning of Doc)
2. Turn Secure Boot ON (instructions at beginning of Doc)
3. Start -> Run: SYSTEM INFORMATION as Administrator
a. VERIFY - PCR7 Configuration value says Binding Possible.

Additional Information: If BitLocker is enabled, the PCR Configuration will say “Bound”. This qualifies as a PASS test result. A result of “Binding Not Possible” is generally due to 1) Secure Boot is disabled or 2) TPM is disabled in UEFI. If you are seeing “Binding Not Possible” and have verified both Secure Boot and TPM are enabled, this could indicate an issue needing additional investigation resulting in a FAIL for this test.
